title: Returns & Exchanges Return Type Schedule: Settlement Form and Entry Terms
content:
Every Returns & Exchanges authorization is opened as one of six return types. The return type is fixed when the return is authorized, and it decides how Marlowe & Finch makes the customer whole and who may open it.

## How the customer is made whole

| Return type | Settlement form |
|---|---|
| Standard Return | Refund to the original tenders of the order |
| Store Credit Return | One new Return Store Credit |
| Size Exchange | Exchange for the same style |
| Instant Exchange | Exchange for the same style |
| Gift Return | One new Return Store Credit |
| Quality Issue Return | Refund to the original tenders of the order |

## Entry terms

Every return type is opened only against an order in status delivered or closed. The further entry terms of each type are:

| Return type | Who may open it | Further entry term |
|---|---|---|
| Standard Return | The customer who placed the order | None |
| Store Credit Return | The customer who placed the order | None |
| Size Exchange | The customer who placed the order | The replacement is the same style at the same price, in a different size or colour |
| Instant Exchange | The customer who placed the order | The original order was paid by card or wallet, and the replacement's value is no more than 400.00 USD |
| Gift Return | A gift recipient with their own Marlowe & Finch profile who quotes the gift order number | The order is flagged as a gift |
| Quality Issue Return | The customer who placed the order | Defect photos are on the return |

## Reading the schedule

- Two return types settle in Return Store Credit (Store Credit Return and Gift Return), two settle to the original tenders (Standard Return and Quality Issue Return), and two replace the item (Size Exchange and Instant Exchange).
- A Gift Return is the only type opened by someone other than the purchaser.
- Example (hypothetical): a customer who placed a delivered order and wants the same jacket one size up, with the replacement at the same price, meets the entry terms of a Size Exchange; the same customer asking for a different jacket style does not, because the replacement must be the same style.
